schema.text: When you use public transport, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or taxi)

schema.help: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

en.#When you use public transport, what do: When you use public transport, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

en.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
en.#I put off or skip some trips: I put off or skip some trips
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: I travel another way (e.g. by car or taxi)
en.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Think about waiting at stops and travelling on board public transport. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

it.#When you use public transport, what do: Quando usi i mezzi pubblici, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o in taxi)
it.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensa all’attesa alla fermata e al viaggio a bordo dei mezzi pubblici. Se fai più di una di queste cose, scegli quella che fai più spesso.
it.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Mi preparo in modo diverso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)

fr.#When you use public transport, what do: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en taxi)
fr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Pensez à l’attente aux arrêts et au trajet à bord des transports en commun. Si vous faites plusieurs de ces choses, choisissez celle que vous faites le plus souvent.
fr.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Je m’équipe autrement (par exemple vêtements, parapluie)

de.#When you use public transport, what do: Was tun Sie bei Fahrten mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln normalerweise, wenn das Wetter schlecht ist (Regen, Wind, Kälte oder große Hitze)?
de.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Nichts ändert sich, ich bin wie gewohnt unterwegs
de.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Es ist weniger angenehm, aber ich bin auf dieselbe Weise unterwegs
de.#I put off or skip some trips: Ich verschiebe oder streiche manche Wege
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Auto oder Taxi)
de.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Denken Sie an das Warten an Haltestellen und die Fahrt in öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Wenn Sie mehrere dieser Dinge tun, wählen Sie das aus, was Sie am häufigsten tun.
de.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: Ich bereite mich anders vor (z. B. Kleidung, Regenschirm)

tr.#When you use public transport, what do: Toplu taşıma kullanırken hava koşulları kötü olduğunda (yağmur, rüzgâr, soğuk veya aşırı sıcak) genellikle ne yaparsınız?
tr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Hiçbir şey değişmez, her zamanki gibi yolculuk ederim
tr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: Daha az keyifli ama aynı şekilde yolculuk ederim
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. otomobille veya taksiyle)
tr.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Duraklarda beklemeyi ve toplu taşıma araçlarında yolculuk yapmayı düşünün. Bunlardan birden fazlasını yapıyorsanız en sık yaptığınızı seçin.

fa.#When you use public transport, what do: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، وقتی هوا بد است (باران، باد، سرما یا گرمای شدید) معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: چیزی تغییر نمی‌کند، مثل همیشه سفر می‌کنم
fa.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: کمتر دلپذیر است، اما به همان شکل سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I put off or skip some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو یا تاکسی)
fa.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: انتظار در ایستگاه‌ها و سفر با وسایل حمل‌ونقل عمومی را در نظر بگیرید. اگر بیش از یکی از این کارها را انجام می‌دهید، کاری را انتخاب کنید که بیشتر انجام می‌دهید.
fa.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: به شکل دیگری آماده می‌شوم (مثلاً لباس، چتر)

hu.#When you use public transport, what do: Tömegközlekedés közben mit szokott tenni, ha rossz az idő (eső, szél, hideg vagy nagy hőség)?
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: Más módon utazom (pl. autóval vagy taxival)
hu.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: Gondoljon a megállókban való várakozásra és a tömegközlekedési járműveken való utazásra. Ha ezek közül többet is tesz, válassza azt, amit a leggyakrabban tesz.

ar.#When you use public transport, what do: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما تصرّفك عادةً عندما يكون الطقس سيئًا (مطر أو رياح أو برد أو حرّ شديد)؟
ar.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: الأمر أقل متعة، لكنني أتنقل بالطريقة نفسها
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or ta: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالسيارة أو سيارة الأجرة)
ar.#Think about waiting at stops and travel: فكّر في الانتظار في المحطات والسفر على متن وسائل النقل العام. إذا كنت تفعل أكثر من أمر من هذه الأمور، فاختر ما تفعله غالبًا.
ar.#I prepare differently (e.g. clothes, um: أستعد بطريقة مختلفة (مثل الملابس أو المظلة)
